description: Erection of a rear roof extension with two front roof windows to the flat
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (GTD190 - 03HPA (Rev A); GTD190 - 04HPA (Rev A)  Received:  11 December 2019;  Location Plan; GTD190 - 01HPA; GTD190 - 02HPA  Received:  22 November 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The rear dormer extension hereby approved shall be clad in matching roof tiles to the original roof and matching white UPVC windows only.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.
